The scene is restrained and recognisable, with a small red accent object, no text, logos, screens or branding.
STORY-SPECIFIC ANCHOR (what makes this picture belong to THIS story)
The relationship between the cost of completing a task and choosing a less expensive option instead of the maximum-intelligence option.
WHAT MUST BE PHYSICALLY VISIBLE, AND WHY
Show a generated dark tabletop metaphor: a large heavy abstract block on one side and a smaller practical tool on the other, positioned like two options being weighed. No text, logos or interface elements; the relationship should make task cost feel like the decision point.
Slide purpose: Объяснить, что автор заменил максимальный показатель интеллекта критерием стоимости выполненной задачи.. Media function: concept.

Показать выбор ИИ-модели как физическое взвешивание: максимальная мощность против стоимости конкретной задачи.
